campaignsText: Storm-1084 has been involved in campaigns aligned with MuddyWater group, targeting regions possibly in the Middle East or North Africa. Their operations involve long-term access and destructive payloads, suggesting a focus on destabilization or data destruction
description: Storm-1084, also known as DEV-1084, is a suspected state-sponsored threat actor linked to the MuddyWater group. They are known for destructive activities such as encrypting on-premise devices and deleting cloud resources. Storm-1084 uses tools like Rport, Ligolo, and custom PowerShell backdoors, suggesting advanced capabilities likely targeting specific sectors with strategic intent.
goals: Storm-1084 likely aims to disrupt or destroy critical infrastructure and gather intelligence through destructive campaigns. Their collaboration with MuddyWater indicates possible alignment with broader Iranian cyber espionage activities targeting Middle Eastern governments and private entities.
